name: compaction-quality
description: Write a context-compaction summary that survives being the only thing the next session has, and prove it. Rebuilt on four deep-research reports plus a new measurement: across 121 real /compact events, rejected approaches survive at 0.3%, standing constraints at 33.8%. Two-tier artifact (a pinned verbatim tier of constraints, corrections, dead ends and exact identifiers, then a narrative tier), extract-then-compress-then-verify ordering, and compaction framed as a last resort against measured alternatives. Ships a deterministic retention scorer and a head-to-head benchmark against Claude Code's own /compact whose baseline arm is free.
